# Existing interfaces are instances of the Becoming spine; comparison extends to every frame under the lifting rule

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Seed–edge closures (WholeGroundCoverage.Reached, CutCoverageAudit.Reach) and evaluator chains (EvaluatorGrounding.Chain) are exactly reachability on the edge process. A frame's reachable configurations form a joint-continuation space: a step- and claim-preserving map carries every jointly realizable bundle, and a summary whose steps lift and whose claims reflect loses none. A robust response is exactly a common response with completion as admissibility, and every robust response is a common response of the judgment process; a guarantee is one-step completion; LiveStep is Enabled; filtering a rule list by one observation is After on a pure observation. The functional articulation of a situation is exactly the articulation under the lifting rule L on the deterministic frame; under L, generative comparison lifts to responses and supplies reasons, survival of coherent selection and the absence of survivors under continual improvement on every frame. L is substantive: a response with one better and one worse outcome is comparable in neither direction under the conservative rule. The core's living significance, generative extension, C, secured positive ground and D are by definition those of GenerativeComparison and PositionedPositiveReason; the practical judgment of basic conditions first, then living gain, on configurations is PracticalJudgment.Better (BetterAt). A judgment is a one-step inquiry: a response is a common response of the judgment process exactly when it is admissible at every believed configuration (the core's commonResponse_judge_iff). In the periphery, with Mathlib, a policy on observations implements correction exactly when its action on each observation value's cell is a common response; a common action exists exactly when every cell has one; a safe choice is a common response on the worlds showing the value; and the refinement theorems of CorrectionBoundary and ObservationChange follow from the core's commonResponse_antitone. Bounded open-form realization applies to a Run of the shared Frame, and the same novel witness receives relevance under the explicit significance condition; two inherited-interface adapters complete the generation-to-positive-ground composition.

Canonical source: [Lifting.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Lifting.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The bridge theorems are definitional identifications and add no normative premise; they transport theorems, and the supplied premises the original theorems need are still needed.
- The lifted results take comparison principle C and the lifted articulation or selection coherence as supplied premises; L is the conservative rule “every outcome better than every outcome”, public as the default by plan §6, with stronger rules optional commitments.
- Direction conventions differ and are kept: GenerativeComparison's Better first second says the second is better; PracticalJudgment's and LiftBetter's better x y says x is better.

By the core convention a configuration retains whatever history the question needs, so taking a module's history type as a frame's configurations is a correspondence choice, not a Lean result. The classification page records, module by module, whether its theorems reach the spine by a bridge, by already being on the core, or by type substitution, and which modules are deliberately not bridged (three Mathlib leaves, concrete models); two Mathlib leaves connect through the peripheral bridge CorrectionInquiry; P3b places the two renewal modules as renewal bounds on runs.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

The current bytes of Becoming.Bridge, Becoming.Lifting (the lifting rule L and its countermodels) and Becoming.EdgeClosure (the seed–edge closure) are bound to the latest consolidated receipt in the references, every source declaration with an empty axiom report. Earlier receipts below checked the same statements under the former names, tabulated in plan section 10. Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): Becoming.Bridge's 40 theorems (Ranking.wholeRun_iff and Ranking.undisturbed_eq belonging to ranking-under-readings, withinClosure_iff_closure to levels-of-closure, the 5 of the Discharge section to one-axiom-yields-g0), with Becoming.Frame's new Reach.map and Reach.lift, all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts, with their propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice listed separately. Controls are not counted as new theorems. The classification check mechanically checks all 46 module rows. Author's review only; no independent review yet. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The core adds commonResponse_judge_iff with an empty axiom report. The peripheral bridge CorrectionInquiry passed a check with Lean 4.30.0-rc2 and Mathlib (ea11ccc0) (20261013T095049.338744Z): 7 theorems/8 declaration audits, all with empty axiom reports; the current bytes of the other 80 modules in its closure, the core included, match passed receipts. P89 (13 October 2026): prior Bridge declarations remain; four added adapters are checked with empty axiom reports. This record binds Bridge to the new frozen receipt while other proofs retain their original receipts; adapters are not independent results.

Adds no normative content: bridges transport theorems without proving their premises, and the meaning of history types and the normative warrant of supplied relations remain the user's to supply. L is only the conservative rule; stronger lifting rules (some-outcome, expectation or risk rules) are not studied. The unification of renewal and consumption and the dynamic reading of `living` are in becoming-renewal-reading. The Mathlib bridge connects only the selection and safety interfaces of CorrectionBoundary and ObservationChange; their randomized bounds and real-valued models are not stated on the core, and the passage by choice to a single policy is not restated.

- L is substantive: from configuration 0, mixed reaches 0 or 4 and high reaches 3; some outcome of mixed beats high, yet the conservative rule compares them in neither direction (LiftModel.some_outcome_does_not_lift). [Lifting.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Lifting.lean)
- Through a middle response with no outcome both lifted comparisons hold vacuously while the composite fails (LiftModel.lift_needs_live_middle). [Lifting.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Lifting.lean)
- Deliberately not bridged: CorrectionParent and ObservationRepair are concrete models and CorrectionRelations is an algebra of relational boundaries, with no core interface; 9 further concrete models have no interface to instantiate. <a id="依赖与关联-dependencies-and-related-results"></a>
## Dependencies and related results

- **formal-reuse**: [metaethical-core-characterization](metaethical-core-characterization.md). comparison_lifts and the lifted theorems directly use the core's Extension, Comparison (C), LiftBetter (L) and Enabled; g0_iff, extension_iff and comparison_iff show that G0, generative extension and C are GenerativeComparison's definitions on the frame's inventory.

**Output:** The definitions of generative comparison principle C on a frame and the conservative lifting rule L.

**Input:** comparison_lifts turns an outcome-wise extension under C into LiftBetter between responses.

**Preserved conditions:** Same frame and `living` reading; the comparison's direction is flipped from GenerativeComparison's convention to LiftBetter's. [Bridge.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/history/becoming/Becoming/Bridge.lean)

- Related, not a proved adapter: [classification-robust-generative-comparison](classification-robust-generative-comparison.md). GenerativeComparison's situated reason, coherent selection and continual-improvement results are the deterministic case of this result's lifted theorems (articulation_iff_lifted); this result generalizes them without calling them.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [practical-judgment-under-living-significance](practical-judgment-under-living-significance.md). robust_iff_commonResponse identifies J's robust judgment with the inquiry layer's common response, so J's robustness theorems apply on the scope of a sound inquiry; J's normative premises are not thereby proved.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [positive-ground-open-futures](positive-ground-open-futures.md). The rule-list revision and joint-bundle transport it uses are cases of revise_is_after and Frame.map_preserves_bundles.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [relational-generative-comparison](relational-generative-comparison.md). With the joint-continuation space taken as a frame's reachable configurations, that result's joint-bundle distinction applies on the spine.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [own-good-to-reachable-living-significance](own-good-to-reachable-living-significance.md). That route's Chain is reachability on the edge process (chain_iff_reach).
- Related, not a proved adapter: [positioned-positive-reason](positioned-positive-reason.md). securesPositiveGround_iff and positionedArticulation_iff show that the core's secured positive ground and D are that result's definitions.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [levels-of-closure](levels-of-closure.md). The core's closure WithinClosure (Becoming.Feedback) is exactly the seed–edge closure here from one seed (withinClosure_iff_closure, Becoming.EdgeClosure).
- Related, not a proved adapter: [continuation-condition-yields-living-significance](continuation-condition-yields-living-significance.md). The bridge's Discharge section belongs there: under the axiom the periphery's G0 holds for every inventory, and three of the periphery's theorems follow from the axiom.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [open-form-realization-under-revision](open-form-realization-under-revision.md). The four checked adapters belong to that existing result, with no new result identity.
